title: Live CI status
description: Run/job status from GitHub webhooks (ci-github-status), with trace-derived test counts joined in.

list.name: pr
list.label: PR
list.description: PR number, or a regex. .* = any PR.

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.description: Pin one run attempt, e.g. 35969934380:1. .* = newest.

options.content: **Shadow mode.** Run and job status straight from GitHub's `workflow_run` / `workflow_job` webhooks (`ci-github-status`), repaired every minute from the Actions API. Test counts are joined from the trace pipeline where a job emits telemetry — *Awaiting test details* means GitHub knows the job but no test series exists yet. **STALE** means status has not been reconciled with GitHub recently: treat it as possibly out of date. Pin a run with `?var-run=<id>:<attempt>`, a PR with `?var-pr=<number>`.

panels.title: Status
panels.description: 1 = no successful reconciliation with GitHub within 3 minutes.

targets.expr: max(ci_github_status_stale)
time() - max(ci_github_status_reconcile_last_success_timestamp_seconds > 0)

panels.title: Last webhook
panels.description: Informational: a quiet repository sends nothing, which is not an outage.

targets.expr: time() - max(ci_github_status_last_delivery_timestamp_seconds > 0)
count(ci_github_run_status < 3 and on (repository, run_id) ci_github_run_info{workflow=~"$workflow"}) or vector(0)
count(ci_github_job_status == 1 and on (repository, run_id) ci_github_run_info{workflow=~"$workflow"}) or vector(0)
count(ci_github_job_status == 2 and on (repository, run_id) ci_github_run_info{workflow=~"$workflow"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Selected run
panels.description: The newest run attempt matching $pr / $run. Follows a new run or rerun on the next refresh.

panels.title: Jobs by test job — status from GitHub, tests from traces
panels.description: Shards are GitHub jobs sharing a test_job. Pass/Fail come from the trace pipeline; empty = awaiting test details. A failed/cancelled job with passing tests means a later step failed — the two are shown separately on purpose.

panels.title: GitHub jobs of the selected run
panels.description: One row per GitHub job, including jobs that emit no telemetry (setup, gates).

targets.expr: max by (job_id, gh_run, name, test_job, conclusion) ((ci_github_job_status) * on (repository, run_id, job_id) group_left(name, test_job, conclusion, gh_run) ((label_replace(ci_github_job_info, "gh_run", "$1", "run_id", "([0-9]+):.*") * on (repository, run_id, job_id) group_left(conclusion) ci_github_job_conclusion_info) or on (repository, run_id, job_id) label_replace(label_replace(ci_github_job_info, "gh_run", "$1", "run_id", "([0-9]+):.*"), "conclusion", "—", "", "")) and on (repository, run_id) topk(1, max by (repository, run_id) ((ci_github_run_started_timestamp_seconds{run_id=~"$run"} or ci_github_run_created_timestamp_seconds{run_id=~"$run"}) * on (repository, run_id) group_left() max by (repository, run_id) (ci_github_run_info{workflow=~"$workflow",pr=~"$pr"}))))
